rationale: Same criterion as exp-0052. StockBear's pruning margins are cp-calibrated (futility 110, reverse-futility 85, delta 200). exp-0049 perturbed eval at RMS 111.83 cp and lost ~160 Elo despite better log-loss, so a new term must stay well inside the smallest margin (85 cp).
rule_if_failed: Tighten the IMPLEMENTATION (cap/weights). Never relax this criterion after seeing the distribution.
